At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!
AI is changing the way consumers discover, evaluate and choose businesses online and Trustpilot is at the centre of that shift. Our reviews are increasingly becoming a trusted source for AI, with Trustpilot ranking as the fifth most cited page on the internet by ChatGPT in January 2026.
As an Account Executive at Trustpilot, you’ll play a key role in helping businesses build trust and turn it into growth. You’ll own new business development across the Dutch market, working with companies to understand their challenges, uncover opportunities, and show them how Trustpilot can help them build credibility, strengthen their reputation, and win more customers.

Proactively build relationships and seek new business opportunities
Generate new business opportunities with prospective clients by targeting various verticals
Take ownership of the full 360 sales cycle (generating leads, demonstrating the product, pricing, negotiation and closing)
Illustrate the value of Trustpilot products and software solutions to demonstrate growth opportunities and return of investment
Compile and analyse data to present trends to prospects and clients
Work closely with your colleagues in Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales development and management to ensure that you offer the best solution to our customers
Build a healthy pipeline to ensure that you’re always exceeding your targets

Fluent in Dutch along with English working proficiency
+3 years experience in a similar full cycle sales role in SaaS and tech
Experienced in MEDDIC/MEDDPICC
History of consistently reaching targets in a similar capacity over the past few years
Demonstrated experience with subscription-based, renewal license models
Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with multiple stakeholders
Professional communication and negotiation skills
Possess a solid ability to manage high-impact conversations in a professional and solution-oriented manner
Enthusiasm for technology and for being a part of a fast-growing SaaS company
A believer in consultative sales, you get a kick out of closing a deal, but you also understand the true value of having only winners at the table
What's in it for you?

25 holiday days
2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app-based service designed to promote positive mental health and access to a 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan
A friendly, fun and close-knit team, where colleagues enjoy spending time together and taking part in different activities.
Commuter allowance
Still not sure?
We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences as well as how you will contribute to our working culture. So, even if you don’t feel you don't meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.
Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.
We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.
Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
Join us at the heart of trust.
Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.
Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.
If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

About WorkWhile
WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs: the true backbone of the hospitality, catering, and event industries. These workers often face highly volatile schedules, sudden booking surges, minimum wage pay, and limited benefits, leading to financial instability.
WorkWhile identifies the best, most reliable hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life.

For high-volume catering companies, stadium and venue operators, corporate food service providers, and large-scale event producers, we provide instant access to a vetted, high-quality workforce to seamlessly scale up for major events and peak periods.

For workers, we provide stable income and unmatched benefits, including next-day pay, free telehealth services, upskilling, and financial wellness tools.
We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work in hospitality and live events.

WorkWhile is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager - Hospitality to join our team and build long-term, trusting relationships with our enterprise hospitality and event clients.

This role is focused on managing a portfolio of high-volume accounts, including catering conglomerates, national contract food service providers, sports and entertainment venue operators, and premier event management groups, ensuring they have the right workforce to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, major event rollouts, and sudden booking surges.
You will serve as the primary point of contact for hospitality enterprise accounts, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, high-stakes nature of food service, catering, and venue management.

Lead Account Relationship: Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for enterprise hospitality and event clients, including staffing planning, shift fulfillment, and ongoing labor strategy.
Build Executive & Regional Alignment: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with regional event/culinary directors, general managers, corporate food service directors, venue concessionaires, and VP-level operations leaders.
Understand Industry Dynamics: Develop a deep understanding of each client’s operational environment, including hyper-seasonal staffing volatility, last-minute event bookings/cancellations, variable labor costs, and guest service standards, to proactively meet their workforce needs.
Drive Contract Growth & Retention: Maintain and grow client accounts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across regional event sites, venue networks, multi-unit properties, or new culinary/hospitality labor categories.
Act as a Trusted Advisor: Develop trusted advisor relationships with key hospitality accounts, aligning WorkWhile's workforce solutions to their operational goals, ROI targets, and guest experience standards.
Ensure Operational Excellence: Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts in line with strict client SLAs, worker reliability metrics, and service quality expectations for high-profile events.
Transparent Stakeholder Communication: Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal operations teams and enterprise client executives.
Track & Forecast Metrics: Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker attendance/performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue retention and expansion.
Deliver Business Reviews: Prepare regular account health reports and quarterly business reviews tailored to venue operators, contract food service executives, and catering leadership teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Sales team to expand WorkWhile's presence across new venue networks or regional operator groups, and collaborate with internal Operations teams to ensure fulfillment during peak periods (e.g., stadium game days, peak catering seasons, major conferences).
Issue Escalation & Resolution: Assist with challenging client requests or live-event operational escalations, providing quick and effective resolutions to minimize disruption to the guest experience.

Experience: 3+ years experience as an Account Manager, ideally within the contract food service, event management, catering, venue operations, or flexible workforce solutions industries.
Deep Hospitality & Event IQ: A profound understanding of the logistics behind large-scale catering, stadium operations, corporate dining, and how workforce reliability directly impacts guest experience and margin.
Executive Presence & Influence: Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels, from regional culinary directors and venue GMs to VP-level hospitality executives.
Multi-Unit Expertise: Experience managing multi-unit, enterprise-scale hospitality accounts, venue networks, or multi-city event portfolios.
Tech Stack Proficiency: Solid experience with CRM software (Salesforce or similar) and Google Suite.
Track Record of Growth: Proven track record of delivering client-focused labor solutions, maintaining high customer retention rates, and hitting revenue growth/expansion targets.
Agility & Attention to Detail: Ability to juggle multiple complex enterprise accounts and fast-moving event timelines while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
Communication Skills: Excellent listening, negotiation, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.
As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Enterprise Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne or Frankfurt.
What you'll be doing
In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.
Our humble expectations
You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in English and German.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.
You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

Sitting at the intersection of commercial strategy and program delivery, you will own the full partnership lifecycle: from commercial framework and launch readiness through to sustained performance and long-term growth. You will define how Arlo organizes and governs large strategic accounts — creating the repeatable playbook that scales — while maintaining direct accountability for the revenue outcomes, delivery execution, and relationship health of the partnerships in your portfolio.

Core Responsibilities
Commercial Ownership & Revenue Accountability
Own full accountability for forecasted revenue and commercial outcomes across your partnership portfolio, with direct reporting visibility to Arlo senior leadership
Build and maintain commercial models that track partnership performance against plan
Define and negotiate commercial frameworks, SOW terms, and performance milestones that align partner commitments with Arlo’s revenue objectives
Identify and develop opportunities to grow commercial scope within existing partnerships, deepening Arlo’s value proposition, driving retention, and expanding the engagement footprint
Account Governance & Delivery Architecture
Define and implement the governance model for how Arlo manages large strategic accounts — building a repeatable, scalable playbook covering stakeholder alignment, workstream management, escalation protocols, and performance reporting
Own program governance structures across engineering, product, operations, legal, and commercial workstreams — ensuring Arlo can consistently deliver on complex, multi-year partner commitments
Establish clear cross-functional accountability frameworks across all internal teams engaged on a given partnership: clear owners, timelines, and escalation paths, so that commitments made to partners are commitments kept
Drive continuous improvement of Arlo’s partnership success model — capturing learning from each partnership cycle and building institutional best practice that others can apply and build on
Cross-Functional Leadership & Launch Readiness
Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Legal to deliver on partnership commitments and ensure readiness for commercial launches
Define and manage commercial timelines, dependencies, and escalations across multiple concurrent workstreams, maintaining pace and accountability throughout
Ensure Arlo presents a single, consistent voice to its partners — with internal positions aligned and commitments validated before they reach the partner
Design & deliver partnership success systems to enable Arlo to scale its partner delivery capacity without proportional increases in management overhead
Stakeholder Management & Executive Relationships
Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
Provide regular, structured updates to Arlo leadership on partnership health, revenue trajectory, launch progress, and risk and opportunity areas
Operate effectively across technical and commercial contexts — translating engineering and product complexity into commercial clarity for executive audiences, and surfacing commercial context to technical teams
Represent Arlo’s partner interests internally with authority, ensuring partner-facing commitments are understood and resourced across all contributing teams

10–15 years of experience in strategic partnerships, account management, or a related field — ideally in SaaS, IoT, smart home, or connected security
Demonstrated track record of owning revenue outcomes in complex, high-value service provider partnerships — not just managing relationships, but holding and delivering against a commercial number
Proven experience designing and implementing partnership success frameworks for large strategic accounts — with experience in building the operating model, not just working within one
Proven track record delivering large-scale platform integrations or commercial programs in B2B2C or service provider environments

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

Account Manager pour Academic Work
A propos du rôle
Don't leave fit to chance ! Chez Academic Work, nous sommes les experts du recrutement des professionnels en début de carrière, avec une ambition claire : devenir LE leader de la prédiction de performance.
Depuis près de 30 ans, nous déployons notre expertise dans 6 pays. Nous continuons notre croissance, et c'est pourquoi nous recherchons deux Account Managers pour renforcer notre équipe genevoise.
Notre bureau de Genève est composé de 25 collaborateurs animés par une culture de l'ambition et de plus de 150 consultants que nous sommes fiers d'accompagner chaque mois. Ce qui nous distingue ? Une culture d'entreprise forte, un engagement sans faille de nos collaborateurs, et une satisfaction client qui nous motive chaque jour à aller plus loin.
Alors, prêt(e) à faire la différence ?
Tâches
Le rôle d'Account Manager est un savant mélange de détermination et de réflexion stratégique. Tu portes en permanence deux casquettes : celle du Hunter, moteur de notre expansion, et celle du Conseiller, partenaire de confiance des chefs d'entreprise. Ton talent ? Savoir ouvrir des portes là où les autres voient des obstacles, puis adapter notre expertise aux réalités du marché et des talents disponibles pour créer une solution unique.

s.h: Concrètement, tu pilotes ton activité autour de quatre axes
s.t:
Prospection et développement de portefeuille : C'est le cœur de ta mission. Tu construis et gères ton propre portefeuille de clients de A à Z. Le cold calling est ton levier quotidien pour convaincre et obtenir des rendez\-vous stratégiques avec des responsables d'entreprise.
Analyse de besoin et négociation : Tu rencontres des directeurs et managers pour analyser leurs besoins. Tu établis les profils de candidats recherchés et mènes les négociations tarifaires. Ton but est de convaincre tes interlocuteurs de la valeur de notre accompagnement pour bâtir des collaborations à long terme.
Expertise marché et synergie interne : Fort de ta connaissance du terrain, tu apportes un regard éclairé à tes clients. Une fois le besoin identifié, tu travailles en lien étroit avec nos recruteurs.
Rigueur et résultats : Tu es responsable de tes performances. Pour assurer des résultats constants, tu appliques nos méthodes de travail avec précision, du premier contact jusqu'à la conclusion de l'accord (le closing).
Nous cherchons un tempérament, pas un CV
Peu importe tes études ou ton passé professionnel, nous cherchons les traits de caractère suivants :
Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile.
Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution.
Le goût de l'accomplissement : Tu as besoin de te fixer des défis pour avancer. Tu aimes la compétition et tu cherches un environnement où tes efforts sont récompensés à leur juste valeur.
Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir.
Le sens de l'autonomie : Tu apprécies la liberté d'organiser tes journées et tu sais faire preuve d'une grande rigueur personnelle pour atteindre tes objectifs.
Prérequis
0 à 3 ans d'expérience après la fin de tes études.
Pas besoin d'expérience en Sales : nous te formons de A à Z via notre AW Sales Academy.
Français parfait et niveau avancé en anglais (C1\).
Permis de conduire (catégorie B).
Ce que nous t'offrons
Un écosystème de high\-performers : Un environnement exigeant et stimulant où l'on se tire vers le haut et où les succès sont célébrés ensemble (voyages, kick\-offs).
L'impact comme véritable moteur : Tu auras un impact direct sur le business de tes clients et sur la trajectoire des jeunes talents.
Think big \& make it happen : Un salaire fixe évolutif et un système de commissions totalement déplafonné. Ici, ton ambition est la seule limite.
L'AW Sales Academy : Un programme d'élite (3 semaines d'onboarding \+ coaching continu) pour transformer ton potentiel en expertise B2B.
Une autonomie stratégique : Une grande liberté pour gérer ton agenda et piloter ton portefeuille de clients.

Das Ende der gedruckten Zeitung wurde immer wieder angekündigt, ist aber auch heute erst in weiter Ferne erkennbar. Die gedruckten Medien sind nach wie vor gefragt auf dem Markt, wobei je nach Region und Land deutliche Auflagenrückgange verzeichnet werden.

Depuis plus de 25 ans, e-novinfo met son expertise et sa proximité au service de ses clients. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, sur notre site de Saint-Prex (VD) nous recherchons notre futur-e :

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.
About this opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional sales professional based in Austria (preferable) OR Switzerland to establish and grow DeepL's presence in the Austrian market. This is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful in a market where we're just getting started.

You will be a key player in our Austrian expansion, bringing together an entrepreneurial approach with deep market knowledge — and you won't be doing it alone. You'll have the full support of an experienced, collaborative international team behind you.

Shape our Austrian market entry: You will be at the forefront of DeepL's expansion into Austria, introducing our market-leading translation services to clients and helping them break down language barriers
Build with purpose: Establish our sales foundation in Austria — creating processes, relationships, and market presence where little currently exists
Become a trusted market expert: Develop deep knowledge of the Austrian business landscape, cultural nuances, and customer needs to position DeepL as a valued and trusted solution
Represent and advocate: Serve as an expert on DeepL's products and your customers' needs, troubleshooting thoughtfully and resolving inquiries with care
Own the full sales cycle: As a trusted partner to new and incoming customers, you will qualify and convert leads and guide opportunities from first contact to close
Set and reach meaningful goals: Work towards monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue goals as we establish our presence in the market together
Cultivate a strong pipeline: Identify and develop new business opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling where it adds real value for clients
Manage diverse opportunities: Respond to inbound prospects and customers, navigating a varied mix of opportunities from qualification through to close
Stay organised and forward-looking: Track opportunity and customer details including use cases, timelines, and next steps to keep things moving smoothly
Connect across teams: Work closely with our diverse, international, and welcoming teams — from SDRs to Marketing — collaborating across borders with openness and curiosity
Qualities we look for
We know that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold people back from applying. If you're excited about this role and feel you have most of what we're looking for, we'd genuinely love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.
Entrepreneurial mindset: You enjoy building from the ground up and feel energised by the challenge of creating something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact
Deep Austrian market knowledge: You have genuine knowledge and appreciation of Austrian business culture, market dynamics, and customer preferences — and you understand what makes the market unique
Cultural fluency: You connect authentically with Austrian clients and partners, and bring a genuine appreciation for local values and business practices
Solid full-cycle sales experience: A proven track record in Enterprise Sales with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals
SaaS expertise: Experience in software sales — especially SaaS — is preferred
Strong communication skills: Excellent organisation, presentation, and communication skills (verbal and written) across multicultural contexts
Adaptability and resilience: You feel comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and can shift priorities while maintaining momentum
Collaborative spirit: You thrive when working as part of a team, enjoy supporting colleagues, and value cross-functional collaboration
Language proficiency: Fluent in both, German and English

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Remote work, flexible hours : we offer a remote work schedule for Austria , enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

NetBox Labs is seeking a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to play a key role in the growth and expansion of our partner business. You will report to the VP of Partnerships. Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to execute: drive NetBox Labs revenue by making our partners a force multiplier for our sales team.

That means hunting for partner opportunities, owning a partner-sourced pipeline, and expanding and deepening our existing partner relationships. This requires you to enable partner sellers to find, position, and win with NetBox Labs across our critical VAR, SI, and Technology Partner channels, from large national VARs to strong regional players.

We are looking for a hungry, high-energy doer; the person who makes things happen. The right candidate is a proven self-starter with initiative and self-sufficiency: someone who builds their own plan, creates their own momentum, and delivers results without waiting for direction.
Two things make this seat distinctive. First, the motion: this is a scaling business with real deal flow, a very active, fast-moving environment closing dozens of deals every quarter. As our platform adds new features and capabilities, we are winning larger and more complex enterprise deals.

You need to keep pace with today’s velocity and bring the experience to help us win upmarket. Second, the team: our sales organization is early in its career and growing fast. We need a CAM whose experience raises the whole team's game; co-selling, coaching deal strategy, and sharing hard-won channel craft.

Everything at NetBox Labs is new, and it changes daily. This role rewards curiosity, adaptability, and the commitment to put in the time to master our platform, our open source community, and our market. Experience here is a foundation to build on — never a playbook to coast on.
In this role you will
Hunt for revenue: prospect relentlessly for new opportunities within and alongside our partners; work with partner sellers and our sales organization to uncover, register, and advance deals in their account bases, bringing the same drive to partner-sourced pipeline that a top seller brings to net-new logos.
Selectively expand the partner portfolio: we are always open to new partners, especially large ones, but our team is lean and we qualify rigorously. Evaluate inbound and prospective partners with discipline, and work with the partner team to onboard only those that meaningfully strengthen our coverage.
Map and develop relationships within the Partner Field and Field Technical organizations: relentlessly discover new contacts, turn them into Champions for NetBox Labs, and convert those relationships into sales opportunities.
Own the number: build, forecast, and be accountable for a robust pipeline of Partner Sourced sales opportunities, and co-sell alongside our Account Executives to move deals from registration to close — at the pace our deal flow demands.
Coach as you close: co-sell with our Account Executives, run deal reviews, and share your channel knowledge and deal instincts that only experience teaches.
Drive joint go-to-market execution: build partner business plans, launch sales campaigns and enablement with partners, and hold both sides accountable for pipeline commitments.
Facilitate the effective and efficient interaction of NetBox Labs field and field technical teams with their counterparts at our partner organizations. Develop and maintain executive relationships with assigned Partners.
Learn relentlessly: invest the time to master the NetBox Labs platform, our open source ecosystem, and the network automation market — and keep learning as the product, the motion, and the market change week to week.
Keep Partner and Partner Deal information accurate and up to date within our CRM system. Provide accurate and timely reporting on key partner indicators and metrics.

Minimum of 3 – 5 years of channel sales experience, with a strong emphasis on managing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), SIs, Boutique consulting firms, and Technology partners in the B2B high-tech space (SaaS, networking, Infrastructure, cybersecurity, etc.).
Proven success in growing and managing a portfolio of partners with a measurable revenue impact: you can point to the pipeline you sourced and deals you helped close.
A strong sales orientation and hunter mentality: hungry, energetic, and treats partner recruitment and pipeline generation the way a quota-carrying seller treats their number.
A demonstrated self-starter who shows initiative and self-sufficiency: you thrive with autonomy, create your own structure, and do not need hand-holding to deliver results.
Range across deal types: you thrive in a very active, fast-moving, deal-rich environment, and you have the skills and mindset for larger, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals as that mix grows.
A coach’s mindset: genuine enjoyment in collaborating with sellers; you measure your impact in the team’s numbers, not just your own.
Learning agility: you quickly master new products, ecosystems, and markets, and you are energized, not exhausted, by an environment where everything is new and changes daily.
Start-up attitude: Ability to prioritize and act on the most important activities while working as a team to respond. Collaboration/coordination with your peers is the key to success. We are extremely fast paced.
Embrace AI: Leveraging AI to accelerate partnerships and add efficiency to your activities will be key. AI allows us to move / respond quickly.
In-depth understanding of partner business models, and sales cycles for a wide variety of partners.
Experience with partner tools including PRM systems, CRM (Hubspot preferred), and deal registration platforms.
Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to influence Partner executives, sales reps, and technical stakeholders.

Experience across the VAR landscape, including large national VARs, regional VARs, and SI/Consulting partners.
Technical background or experience in networking, enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, or security.
Startup experience at an organization experiencing hypergrowth.
Knowledge or background with partners in Networking, Network Engineering, and/or Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.
NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.
NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.
We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.
This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity open to candidates in Eastern Time Zone Canada.
Build the Future of AI-Powered Marketing
We’re not building another AI writing tool.
At contentmarketing.ai , we’re redefining how marketing teams create content — combining AI-driven workflows across research, writing, QA, and SEO with real strategic rigor. The result: scalable, brand-aligned content that actually performs.
Backed by 18+ years of digital marketing expertise, Brafton has evolved from a leading content agency into a SaaS-driven business serving clients in 125+ countries.
We’re now scaling — and we’re looking for commercially driven Account Executives who understand both sales and modern marketing .

This is a quota-carrying, revenue-driving role focused on new business acquisition and account growth across small and mid-sized businesses.
You will own the full sales cycle — from inbound and outbound opportunity generation through to close — while also driving expansion within your accounts.
This is a high-activity, high-impact role , but success isn’t just about volume — it’s about understanding marketing challenges and clearly demonstrating ROI to marketing and business leaders.
You’ll engage directly with stakeholders across marketing and leadership teams, translating their goals (traffic, rankings, leads, pipeline, revenue) into scalable content strategies powered by contentmarketing.ai.
You should be confident, consultative, and commercially focused — able to build trust quickly, challenge when needed, and close decisively.
What You’ll Own
Full-cycle sales: prospecting, inbound conversion, closing, and expansion
Managing a high volume of opportunities across SMB and mid-market accounts
Running efficient, insight-driven discovery focused on marketing goals and performance gaps
Translating marketing challenges (SEO, content production, lead generation) into clear, ROI-driven solutions for both marketing and business leaders
Positioning contentmarketing.ai as a faster, smarter way to scale content and improve marketing performance
Driving upsell and renewal opportunities within existing accounts
Maintaining disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting in HubSpot
Structuring and closing commercial agreements (contracts, MSAs, addendums)

3 years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, digital marketing, or a similar space
Strong understanding of digital marketing concepts (SEO, content strategy, demand generation, or performance marketing)
Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota in a high-volume sales environment
Experience managing multiple deals simultaneously with shorter sales cycles
Ability to engage credibly with marketing and business leaders and translate their goals into solutions
Comfortable running consultative sales conversations without overcomplicating the process
What Sets You Apart
You can speak the language of both marketers and commercial decision-makers
You connect product value directly to outcomes like traffic, leads, pipeline, and revenue
You balance speed with substance — moving deals forward while adding real insight
You build trust quickly and guide prospects toward decisions
You’re organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined in managing your pipeline
You bring energy, curiosity, and a strong desire to win
Why This Role
High-growth space: AI + marketing is scaling rapidly
Differentiated product: More than a writing tool — a structured content system
Real earning potential: Strong base + uncapped commission
Ownership: You control your pipeline and outcomes
Momentum: Join at a key stage of growth with real opportunity to scale with the business

Additional Information
Benefits Include: Competitive Incentive plan, Health Savings Account, pension, paid vacation, flexible remote schedule, and more!

Account Executive (US)
Affiliate & Influencer Marketing — Acceleration Partners

This is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners, a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm. Occasional travel may be required for internal meetings or conferences. Applicants must be based in the U.S. in the Eastern or Central time zone.

We're looking for an Account Executive to manage and convert inbound demand for our Affiliate and Influencer Marketing Services. This is an operational, full-cycle closing role: our marketing team generates the leads, and you qualify, route, and run the sales process on the opportunities that come to you, taking deals under $250K in annual contract value from first conversation through signed contract yourself.
This is not a prospecting or outbound role; you won't be expected to build your own pipeline from scratch. Your focus is on being an excellent steward of the leads we generate: qualifying quickly and accurately, routing anything outside your scope to the right owner, and running a tight, credible sales process across a steady flow of inbound opportunities.

Inbound Lead Management & Qualification: Own the intake of inbound leads generated by our marketing team. Qualify each opportunity quickly and accurately, and route anything outside your scope (by deal size or segment) to the right owner.
Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Manage qualified deals under $250K ACV from first contact through close, including negotiation and contracting. Own the timeline and keep the process moving.
Consultative Program Strategy: Ask the right questions, understand each prospect's business challenges, and build the strategic recommendation yourself, showing how Affiliate and Influencer Marketing can drive measurable growth for their business.
Pitch Delivery & Presentation: Present your recommendation directly to the prospect. You're the face of the strategy in the room; marketing and sales support can help with collateral and modeling, but the pitch is yours to deliver.
Pipeline Discipline & Subject Matter Expertise: Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting on your book of inbound opportunities, and stay current on the Affiliate and Influencer Marketing space so you're a credible, trusted advisor to every prospect you engage.

Sales Experience
Demonstrated track record of closing deals under $250K in annual contract value, owning the strategic pitch yourself without handing it off
Comfortable managing a fast-moving, full sales cycle, sometimes with multiple stakeholders, sometimes with a single decision-maker
Experience selling into marketing or ecommerce departments at growing or mid-sized companies is a strong plus
Digital Marketing Knowledge
Deep understanding of the digital marketing space, with specific knowledge in one or more of: Affiliate / Influencer, customer acquisition strategy, revenue growth marketing, mobile marketing, CRM and lifecycle marketing, or ecommerce growth channels
Ability to speak credibly with marketing buyers about performance, measurement, and channel strategy, since you're building and delivering that argument yourself
Technical & Tools Proficiency
Salesforce, required; HubSpot an advantage
AI fluency, using AI tools to work smarter in research, proposal development, or pipeline management
Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Independent, Full-Cycle Selling
Comfortable owning a deal solo, from qualified inbound lead through signed contract, pulling in marketing or sales support for collateral and modeling but not reliant on anyone else to carry the narrative
Strong time management and prioritization across a steady flow of inbound opportunities
Sharp qualification instincts and good judgment about what to route elsewhere
Mature judgment, adaptability, and the ability to solve problems independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment
AI fluent and committed to continuous improvement

3+ years of digital marketing or marketing services sales experience
Demonstrated experience closing full-cycle deals independently, without dedicated strategy or account management support
Experience selling into marketing and/or ecommerce departments at mid-sized or growing brands
Experience managing and qualifying inbound lead flow
Salesforce required; HubSpot an advantage
A genuine interest in AI tools, including hands-on experience integrating AI into your work
Must be based in the US in the Eastern or Central time zone

By 3 Months… You're fully up to speed on Acceleration Partners' value proposition, services, and sales process. You're efficiently qualifying and routing inbound leads, running full sales cycles solo on your qualified opportunities, and can position our managed services against client needs without help building the pitch.
By 1 Year… You've closed multiple deals sourced through inbound flow, contributed to sales process improvements, sharpened how leads get qualified and routed, and built a reputation as a seller who can run a deal from first inbound conversation to signature on your own.

Build and manage a sales pipeline to meet or exceed software and services sales quotas within your book of business

Your AEs build and manage territory plans, prospect a significant share of their own pipeline, run discovery calls and platform demos, build ROI-driven business cases, and guide government agencies through procurement to close — typically on 3 to 8 month sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and government procurement processes.

We sell to government agencies with consultative sales cycles that require thorough discovery, strong relationships, and a genuine passion for improving public transit. Every deal matters — not just for revenue, but because each new agency means better service for the riders who depend on it.
To ensure we are making an impact throughout the sales process, we use a value-driven sales methodology. Our GTM teams are trained on the SPICED methodology, which serves as a blueprint for achieving sales targets, and we expect our sales managers to coach and reinforce it across their teams.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. Field Support: Join FSAs in the field to support complex or at-risk acquisition opportunities where direct engagement is needed.
Pipeline Management: Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date CRM records across your team on a daily basis.
Process & Quality Assurance
Process Adherence: Ensure all field activity is executed in line with the business's acquisition playbook and within agreed timelines.
Quality Control: Review and score FSA fieldwork quality; share structured feedback in weekly team review sessions.
Handoff Management: Coordinate a seamless handoff from FSAs to Implementation and Data Entry teams following a successful acquisition.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Relay structured feedback on lead quality, market conditions, and field blockers to the Growth and Marketing teams.
Leadership Reporting: Provide leadership with clear weekly reports on team field activity, acquisition rates, recruitment status, and immediate blockers.
Experience & Background
4–5 years of total experience in field sales, B2B sales, or territory management.
At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead, coordinator, or supervisory capacity.
Demonstrated experience recruiting or building commission-based sales teams, either formally or as part of a team lead role.
Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding acquisition or sales quotas.
Experience coaching and developing junior field sales reps on activity execution and objection handling.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical field sales experience preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Natural Team Builder: Proven ability to find the right people, bring them in, and get them performing fast.
Frontline Leader: Ready to lead from the front with no hesitation going into the field alongside FSAs to model what great acquisition looks like.
Balanced Management Style: Ability to balance accountability with empathy, holding people to numbers to genuinely drive their professional growth.
Data-Informed & People-First: Skillful use of daily activity metrics to coach rather than micromanage.
Agility & Focus: Highly adaptable to fast-paced, high-growth environments with the ability to manage competing regional priorities seamlessly.
Radical Ownership: Deep commitment to regional outcomes, celebrating wins together, and treating misses as learning opportunities.
Communication & Tools: Strong verbal and written communication skills to deliver structured feedback, run effective team meetings, and represent the region to leadership. Comfort with sales work tools and daily pipeline management workflows.
What success looks like in this role
Weeks 1–2: Complete full product and playbook onboarding. Shadow all FSAs in the field. Establish cadences with team members. Audit the existing FSA recruitment pipeline and playbook.
Weeks 3–4: Run first structured field review sessions. Identify any headcount gaps and initiate active FSA recruitment in understaffed states.
Month 2: Fully own regional KPI tracking on a weekly basis. Fill open FSA roles and ensure all new hires are progressing through onboarding on schedule.
Month 3: Region achieves 85%–100% of the monthly acquisition quota. FSAs have active coaching plans in place, and the recruitment pipeline remains healthy.

Business Development Manager, Partnerships | Bókun
About Tripadvisor
The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences.

We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc.

(Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.
About Bókun
Bókun, a fast-growing subsidiary of Tripadvisor Inc., is a leading reservation system and channel management platform for tours and activities operators globally that enables them to streamline their back-end operations and connect to an ecosystem of online travel agents to grow their business.

At Bókun, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower our clients to grow their businesses and enhance customer experiences. As a key player in travel technology, Bókun combines the agility of a startup with the stability of a publicly traded organisation.

We're growing our Partnerships team and looking for a driven, closer-first Business Development Manager to join our existing partnerships team.
This is a sales role first. You'll build relationships and close commercial agreements with partners across Bókun's full partnerships portfolio — rather than owning one narrow programme. You'll be equally comfortable pitching and negotiating with a founder running a five-person tour operator and a director at an enterprise OTA, and confident owning a deal from first conversation through to signed contract.
Because we're a small, high-ownership team, you'll move fluidly across partnership types as priorities shift, and you'll have real input into how our wider commercial approach and partnerships process evolve — not just execute against what already exists.

Build and run your own pipeline of prospective partners across Bókun's partnership types, from first outreach through negotiation to signed contract.
Lead meetings and negotiations with partners and stakeholders at every seniority level — from founders to enterprise decision-makers — and close agreements that drive measurable value for Bókun.
Represent Bókun's full partnerships value proposition in every conversation: you're selling Bókun first, a specific partnership type second.

s.h: Relationship growth (once a deal is signed)
s.t:
Maintain and grow the commercial relationships you build, ensuring partners stay engaged and continue to deliver value for Bókun.
Track and report your pipeline and closed business against clear sales targets.

Flex across all partnership types as priorities shift — this is not a single-programme role.
Contribute to improving our commercial templates, negotiation playbook and partnerships process more broadly.

At least 5 years of business development / sales experience, ideally in SaaS, marketplaces, or travel technology — a proven track record of sourcing and closing your own deals, not just managing existing ones.
Confident and polished presenting, pitching and negotiating with stakeholders at every seniority level, from founders to C-suite/director-level executives.
Strong contract negotiation skills — comfortable owning commercial terms through to signature.
A genuine hunter: motivated by building pipeline and closing, not solely by managing what's already signed.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills, with near-native business English.
Nice to have: experience in the tours & activities / experiences industry.
Nice to have: understanding of how two-sided marketplaces work (balancing supply and demand sides) — deep reseller-programme or API/connectivity knowledge is not required and can be learned on the job.
Comfortable working in a small, fast-moving team where priorities shift and you'll be asked to cover ground outside your core remit.
Other European languages are a plus.
A strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset

Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Traveler first
We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge
We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together
The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Sie verantworten den Aufbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen in der Ihnen zugeteilten Region und begleiten den gesamten Verkaufsprozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum Abschluss. Eigeninitiativ gehen Sie auf potenzielle Neukunden zu und gewinnen aktiv Geschäftskunden im B2B\-Umfeld, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Sie sind eine ausgeprägte Hunter\-Persönlichkeit mit echter Verkaufs\-DNA: Sie lieben die Neukundenakquise, gehen proaktiv auf den Markt zu und brennen für den Abschluss. Biss, Zielstrebigkeit und die Fähigkeit, auch nach Rückschlägen dranzubleiben, zeichnen Sie aus. Ausgeprägte Abschluss\- und Verhandlungsstärke sowie ein sicheres Auftreten auf allen Hierarchiestufen bis auf C\-Level gehören ebenso zu Ihrem Profil wie unternehmerisches, ergebnisorientiertes Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.
